function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()

    elseif level == 3 then

    elseif level == 1 then

    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

    prepToken()

end

    prepToken()

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil

    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()

        assist_token = nil
    end
end

    end

        assist_token = nil
    end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end --I should like to thank MrStump, who has already done all the legwork which I shamefully steal.
--Set this to true while editing and false when you have finished
disableSave = false
buttonFontColor = {-1,-1,-1,15}
buttonColor = {1,1,1,0.4}
buttonScale = {1,1,1}

defaultButtonData = {
    textbox = {
                	{
          pos       = {0.0,0.8,-0.49},
		          rot       = {-60.0,0.0,0},
          rows      = 2,
          width     = 3880,
          font_size = 370,
          label     = "Click here to edit your\nname & pronouns!",
          value     = "",
          alignment = 3
	                },

        }
}

--[[buttonScale = {0.4,0.4,0.4}
    
        }
]]

--Save function
function updateSave()
    saved_data = JSON.encode(ref_buttonData)
    if disableSave==true then saved_data="" end
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

--Startup procedure
function onload(saved_data)
    if disableSave==true then saved_data="" end
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        ref_buttonData = loaded_data
    else
        ref_buttonData = defaultButtonData
    end

    spawnedButtonCount = 0
    createTextbox()
end



--Updates saved value for given text box
function click_textbox(i, value, selected)
    if selected == false then
        ref_buttonData.textbox[i].value = value
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Dud function for if you have a background on a counter
function click_none() end

function createTextbox()
    for i, data in ipairs(ref_buttonData.textbox) do
        --Sets up reference function
        local funcName = "textbox"..i
        local func = function(_,_,val,sel) click_textbox(i,val,sel) end
        self.setVar(funcName, func)

        self.createInput({
            input_function = funcName,
            function_owner = self,
            label          = data.label,
            alignment      = data.alignment,
            position       = data.pos,
            			rotation       = data.rot,
            scale          = buttonScale,
            width          = data.width,
            height         = (data.font_size*data.rows)+24,
            font_size      = data.font_size,
            color          = buttonColor,
            font_color     = buttonFontColor,
            value          = data.value,
        })
    end
end function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end
]]

function onObjectSpawn()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Load LUA script to units", loadLuaScript)
end

function onLoad()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Load LUA script to units", loadLuaScript)

function loadLuaScript()
    local tokens = getObjectsWithAnyTags({"NATO", "WP"})

    for _, child in ipairs(tokens) do
        local script = child.getLuaScript();
        
        if not string.match(script, "SCRIPT VERSION 2.2") then
            child.setLuaScript(UNIT_LUA_SCRIPT)
        end
    end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- set to a color to have the tray return a static color, otherwise it
-- will compute on based on the counters' tint color
local trayStaticColor = nil

-- this function is used to detect if a game object is a counter or
-- not, tweak this if your counters aren't being detected by default
function isCounter(o)
   if not o then
      return false
   end
   return o.name == "Custom_Tile" and o.getScale().x < 2
end



local trayCount = 0

function onLoad(saved_data)

   if saved_data and saved_data ~= "" then
      local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
      for k, guid in ipairs(loaded_data) do
         local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
         if obj ~= nil then
            obj.addContextMenuItem(
               "Explode Stack",
               function (player)
                  explodeStack(
                     {
                        player=Player[player],
                        triggerObj=obj
                     }
                  )
               end
            )
         end
      end
   end

   -- self.interactable = false
   -- self.setLock(true)
   -- self.setPosition({-20.94, -1, 32.49})

   addHotkey("explode", function (player, obj)
                if (obj ~= nil) and isCounter(obj) then
                   explodeStack({player=Player[player], triggerObj=obj})
                end
   end)
   
end

function onObjectSpawn(obj)
   if isCounter(obj) then
      obj.addContextMenuItem("Explode Stack", function (player)
                                explodeStack({player=Player[player], triggerObj=obj})
      end)
   end
end

function onSave()
   local counters = {}
   for k, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
      if isCounter(obj) then
         table.insert(counters, obj.getGUID())
      end
   end
   saved_data = JSON.encode(counters)
   return saved_data
end

function getTrayCounters(tray)
   local bounds = tray.getBounds()
   local objs = findRight(
      {
         pos = {
            (bounds.center.x-bounds.size.x/2),
            bounds.center.y+5,
            bounds.center.z
         },
         size = {
            0.1,
            10,
            bounds.size.z,
         },
         distance = bounds.size.x
      }
   )
   
   table.sort(
      objs,
      function(a, b)
         local posA = a.getBounds().center
         local posB = b.getBounds().center
         if posA.x == posB.x or (math.abs(posA.x - posB.x) <= 0.1) then
            return posA.y < posB.y
         end
         return posA.x > posB.x
      end
   )

   return objs
end

function repack (player, value)
   local tray = getObjectFromGUID(value)
   if tray then
      local placeholder = getObjectFromGUID(tray.getVar("placeholder"))
      if placeholder then
         placeholder.destruct()
      end
      local btn = getObjectFromGUID(tray.getVar("btn"))
      if btn then
         btn.destruct()
      end

      local origin = tray.getTable("stackOrigin")

      local objs = getTrayCounters(tray)


      for i, o in ipairs(objs) do
         if isCounter(o) then
            local pos = {
               x = origin.x,
               y = origin.y+(i*0.25),
               z = origin.z,
            }
            o.setPositionSmooth(pos, false, true)
            o.use_grid = true
            o.use_snap_points = false
         end
      end
      tray.destruct()
      trayCount = trayCount - 1
   end
end

function spawnRepackButton(tray)

   local trayBounds = tray.getBounds()

   local pos = tray.positionToWorld(Vector(0, 0, 0))
   
   local btn = spawnObject({
         type              = "BlockSquare",
         position          = pos - Vector(0, 0, trayBounds.size.z/4),
         rotation          = {0, 0, 0},
         scale             = {1, 0.1, 1},
         callback_function = function (o)
            o.setLock(true)
            o.setColorTint({0, 0, 0, 0})
            o.interactable = false
            tray.setVar("btn", o.getGUID())
            local trayNumber = tray.getVar("number")
            o.UI.setXmlTable({
                  {
                     tag = "Panel",
                     attributes = {
                        id = tray.getGUID() .. "-panel",
                        width = "200.0",
                        height = 125,
                        position = "0 -90 -100",
                        allowDragging = true,
                        rectAlignment = "MiddleCenter",
                        onEndDrag = "d34970/move(".. tray.getGUID() .. ")"
                     },
                     children = {
                        {
                           tag = "VerticalLayout",
                           children = {
                              {
                                 tag = "Text",
                                 attributes = {
                                    color="#dcdccc",
                                    resizeTextForBestFit = true,
                                 },
                                 value = "#" .. tostring(trayNumber)
                              },
                              {
                                 tag = "Button",
                                 attributes = {
                                    color="#1c1c1c",
                                    textColor="#dcdccc",
                                    resizeTextForBestFit = true,
                                    onClick= "d34970/repack(".. tray.getGUID() .. ")"
                                 },
                                 value = "Repack"
                              },
                              {
                                 tag = "Button",
                                 attributes = {
                                    color="#1c1c1c",
                                    textColor="#dcdccc",
                                    resizeTextForBestFit = true,
                                    onClick = "d34970/move(".. tray.getGUID() .. ")"
                                 },
                                 value = "Drag to Move"
                              }
                        }}

                     }

            }})
            -- tray.addAttachment(o)
         end
   })

   return btn
end


function move(player, value, panelID)
   -- log(player, "exploder.move")
   -- log(value, "exploder.move")
   -- log(panelID, "exploder.move")
   local tray = getObjectFromGUID(value)

   if tray == nil then
      return
   end

   local btn = getObjectFromGUID(tray.getVar("btn"))
   if btn == nil then
      return
   end

   local cursorPos = player.getPointerPosition()
   local curPos = tray.getPosition()
   local trayBounds = tray.getBounds()

   local objs = getTrayCounters(tray)

   local trayScale = getTrayScale(objs)

   tray.setScale(trayScale)

   
   local trayPos = Vector(cursorPos.x, curPos.y, cursorPos.z+1)
   local trayScale = tray.getScale().x

   local testTrayCollision = function ()

      local objList = Physics.cast({
            origin=trayPos - Vector(trayBounds.size.x/2, 0, 0), direction={1, 0, 0}, type=3,
            size={0.1, 0.15, trayBounds.size.z + 1.25}, max_distance=trayBounds.size.x,
            debug=false
      })
      -- log(objList, "testCollision")
      if #objList > 0 then
         local needsMove = false
         for i, hit in ipairs(objList) do
            if not isCounter(hit.hit_object) then
               local hitGUID = hit.hit_object.getGUID()
               if hitGUID ~= tray.getGUID() and hitGUID ~= btn.getGUID() then
                  needsMove = true
               end
            end
         end
         if needsMove then
            trayPos:setAt('z', trayPos.z + 0.5)
            return false
         end
         return true
      end
      return true
   end

   local moveTray = function (pos)
      
      tray.setPosition(pos, false, true)

      btn.setPosition(pos - Vector(0, 0, trayBounds.size.z/4), false, true)


      -- log(objs)
      -- log(reverseTable(objs))

      layoutCounters(reverseTable(objs), tray, {
                        x = pos.x,
                        y = pos.y,
                        z = pos.z,
      })

   end

   Wait.condition(
      function ()
         moveTray(trayPos)
      end,
      function ()
         return testTrayCollision(tray.getGUID(), trayPos, trayBounds.size)
      end
   )


   
   
   -- tray.interactable = true
   -- tray.setLock(false)
   -- tray.addToPlayerSelection(player)
   
end

function reverseTable ( tab )
   local size = #tab
   local newTable = {}

   for i,v in ipairs ( tab ) do
      newTable[size-(i-1)] = v
   end

   return newTable
end

function getTrayScale(objs)
   local objWidth = 0
   local objHeight = 0
   for i, o in ipairs(objs) do
      local oSize = o.getBounds().size
      objWidth = objWidth + oSize.x
      if oSize.z > objHeight then
         objHeight = oSize.z
      end
   end

   return Vector(objWidth + (0.25*(#objs+1)), 0.1, objHeight * 1.5)
end

function explodeStack(params)
   local player = params.player
   local triggerObj = params.triggerObj
   if not isCounter(triggerObj) or triggerObj.getVar("exploded") then
      return
   end
   -- log("exploding from " .. triggerObj.getName())

   local bounds = triggerObj.getBounds()

   local objs = findBelow({bounds.center.x, bounds.center.y+0.9, bounds.center.z})
   -- log(objs, "exploder.explodeStack")

   if #objs < 2 then
      if objs[1].getPosition().y > 1.5 then
         return
      end
   end
   
   table.sort(objs, function(a, b)
                 local posA = a.getBounds().center
                 local posB = b.getBounds().center
                 return bounds.center.y - posA.y < bounds.center.y - posB.y
   end)

   -- log(objs)bounds.center.z
   -- log(#objs)

   local trayScale = getTrayScale(objs)

   local trayPos = Vector(bounds.center.x+0.5+ (trayScale.x/2), bounds.center.y + 3, bounds.center.z)

   local testCollision = function ()
      local objList = Physics.cast({
            origin=trayPos, direction={1, 0, 0}, type=3,
            size={trayScale.x, 0.15, trayScale.z+1.25}, max_distance = 0.01,
            debug=false
      })
      if #objList > 0 then
         trayPos:setAt('z', trayPos.z + 0.5)
         return false
      end
      return true
   end

   local spawnTray = function()

      trayCount = trayCount + 1
      local trayNumber = trayCount
      
      local tray = spawnObject({
            type              = "BlockSquare",
            position          = trayPos,
            rotation          = {0, 0, 0},
            scale             = trayScale,
            callback_function = function (o)
               o.setLock(true)
               o.setColorTint({0, 0, 0, 0})
               o.setTable("stackOrigin", bounds.center)
               o.setTable("stackObjs", objs)
               o.setVar("number", trayNumber)
               o.interactable = false
               local tray = o


               spawnRepackButton(o)

               local trayColor = layoutCounters(objs, tray, trayPos)

               -- local factor = math.random(1, 2) / 2
               -- trayColor:set(trayColor.r * factor, trayColor.g * factor, trayColor.b * factor)
               tray.setColorTint(trayColor)

               local placeholderY = objs[#objs].getPosition().y
               local placeholderPos = Vector(bounds.center.x, placeholderY, bounds.center.z)
               
               spawnPlaceholder(tray, placeholderPos)


            end,
            sound             = false,
            snap_to_grid      = false,
      })

   end

   Wait.condition(spawnTray, testCollision)

end

function layoutCounters(objs, tray, trayPos)
   local traySnaps = {}

   local traySize = tray.getBounds().size
   local posX = (trayPos.x-(traySize.x/2))+0.25

   local colorTotals = {r = 0, g = 0, b = 0}
   local counterCount = 0
   for i, o in ipairs(objs) do
      if isCounter(o) then
         local oSize = o.getBounds().size
         posX = posX + (oSize.x/2)
         local pos = {
            x = posX,
            y = trayPos.y + 0.5,
            z = trayPos.z,
         }
         counterCount = counterCount + 1
         local cColor = o.getColorTint()
         colorTotals.r = colorTotals.r + cColor.r
         colorTotals.g = colorTotals.g + cColor.g
         colorTotals.b = colorTotals.b + cColor.b
         table.insert(traySnaps, {position=tray.positionToLocal({pos.x, trayPos.y, pos.z})})
         o.setPositionSmooth(pos, false, true)
         o.use_snap_points = true
         o.use_grid = true
         o.removeFromPlayerSelection(table.concat(o.getSelectingPlayers(), "|"))
         
         posX = posX + (oSize.x/2) + 0.25
      end
   end

   
   tray.setSnapPoints(traySnaps)

   if trayStaticColor ~= nil then
      return trayStaticColor
   end
   
   local tint = Color(colorTotals.r/counterCount, colorTotals.g/counterCount, colorTotals.b/counterCount, 0.75)
   local threshold = 0.5
   local reduction = 0.25
   while tint.r > threshold or tint.g > threshold or tint.b > threshold do
      tint:setAt('r', tint.r * (1-reduction))
      tint:setAt('g', tint.g * (1-reduction))
      tint:setAt('b', tint.b * (1-reduction))
   end
   -- return 
   return tint
end

   local placeholderRot = Vector(0, 0, 0)
   if Grid.type == 3 then
      placeholderRot:setAt("y", 90)
   end
   local placeholderMesh = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1188335830309261147/116300B0EF693BCDCCC7B85E688FBCCDD420AF5A/"
   -- local placeholderMesh = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1053227062934624263/F2B5C045A8A75F46E88A743217DD56214168FFE1/"
   local placeholder = spawnObject({
         type              = "Custom_Model",
         position          = pos,
         rotation          = placeholderRot,
         scale             = {0.3, 0.3, 0.3},
         callback_function = function (o)
            o.setLock(true)
            o.setColorTint(tray.getColorTint())
            tray.setVar("placeholder", o.getGUID())
            o.interactable = false
            local trayNumber = tray.getVar("number")
            o.UI.setXmlTable({
                  {
                     tag = "Panel",
                     attributes = {
                        width = "200",
                        padding = 7,
                        height = 200,
                        position = "0 0 -20",
                        -- color="#1c1c1c",
                     },
                     children = {
                        {
                           tag = "VerticalLayout",
                           children = {
                              {
                                 tag = "Text",
                                 attributes = {
                                    color="#dcdccc",
                                    -- color="#"..tray.getColorTint():toHex(false),
                                    -- resizeTextForBestFit = "true",
                                    fontSize="100",
                                    fontStyle="Bold",
                                 },
                                 value = "#" .. tostring(trayNumber)
                              }
                        }}
                     }

            }})
         end,
         sound = false,
         snap_to_grid = false,
   })

   placeholder.setCustomObject({
         mesh = placeholderMesh,
         type = 1,
         material = 3,
   })
end

function findBelow(pos)
   local objList = Physics.cast({
         origin=pos, direction={0,-1,0}, type=1,
         debug=false
   })
   
   local refinedList = {}
   for _, obj in ipairs(objList) do
      if isCounter(obj.hit_object) then
         table.insert(refinedList, obj.hit_object)
      end
   end

   return refinedList

end

function findRight(params)
   local pos = params.pos
   local size = params.size
   local distance = params.distance
   local func = params.filter
   local objList = Physics.cast({
         origin=pos, direction={1,0,0}, type=3,
         size=size, max_distance=distance,
         debug=false
   })

   local refinedList = {}
   for _, obj in ipairs(objList) do
      if isCounter(obj.hit_object) then
         table.insert(refinedList, obj.hit_object)
      end
   end

   return refinedList

    end

--I should like to thank MrStump, who has already done all the legwork which I shamefully steal.
--Set this to true while editing and false when you have finished
disableSave = false
buttonFontColor = {-1,-1,-1,15}
buttonColor = {1,1,1,0.4}
buttonScale = {1,1,1}

defaultButtonData = {
    textbox = {
                	{
          pos       = {0.0,0.8,-0.49},
		          rot       = {-60.0,0.0,0},
          rows      = 2,
          width     = 3880,
          font_size = 370,
          label     = "Click here to edit your\nname & pronouns!",
          value     = "",
          alignment = 3
	                },

        }
}

--[[buttonScale = {0.4,0.4,0.4}
    
        }
]]

--Save function
function updateSave()
    saved_data = JSON.encode(ref_buttonData)
    if disableSave==true then saved_data="" end
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

--Startup procedure
function onload(saved_data)
    if disableSave==true then saved_data="" end
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        ref_buttonData = loaded_data
    else
        ref_buttonData = defaultButtonData
    end

    spawnedButtonCount = 0
    createTextbox()
end



--Updates saved value for given text box
function click_textbox(i, value, selected)
    if selected == false then
        ref_buttonData.textbox[i].value = value
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Dud function for if you have a background on a counter
function click_none() end

function createTextbox()
    for i, data in ipairs(ref_buttonData.textbox) do
        --Sets up reference function
        local funcName = "textbox"..i
        local func = function(_,_,val,sel) click_textbox(i,val,sel) end
        self.setVar(funcName, func)

        self.createInput({
            input_function = funcName,
            function_owner = self,
            label          = data.label,
            alignment      = data.alignment,
            position       = data.pos,
            			rotation       = data.rot,
            scale          = buttonScale,
            width          = data.width,
            height         = (data.font_size*data.rows)+24,
            font_size      = data.font_size,
            color          = buttonColor,
            font_color     = buttonFontColor,
            value          = data.value,
        })
    end
end text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

  color = {0,0,0,0}
  })

  max_val = input_value
  name_update()
end

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})
