function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end     if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Model_Bag
ObjectStates.Description:
This is a Bag. You can insert your own dice to replace the old ones, or insert named object and add them to your rolls using the Misc button.

~Marum
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
local lastEditor
local panelID
local thrownDice = {}
local editing = false

local queuedRolls = {}
local targetMarker = nil
local lastRemove = 0

local diceData = {}
local consts = {}
local rollData = {}
local settings = {}
local diceAreRolling = false
local defaultRoll = ""
local state = 0

local optionsOpen = false
local configuringRollID = 0
local configuringAliases = false

local absoluteTargetPosition = Vector(0,0,0)
local relativeTargetPosition = Vector(0,0,0)

local currentRoll = {}
local currentRollString = ""
local keepingHighest = false
local keepingLowest = false
local countingOnes = false
local countingSixes = false
local dropHighest = false
local dropLowest = false
local suffix = ""
local rolling = ""
local alting = false
local canceling = false
local rollingPlayer = nil
local rollingLabel = ""

local linkingAlias = -1
local dirty = false

local rollHidden = false
local rollingWaitCondition = 0
local autoCleanupWait = 0
local lastClick = 0

local linkingInProgress = nil
local linkingData = nil

local icons = {"Dice_d4", "Dice_d6", "Dice_d8", "Dice_d10", "Dice_d12", "Dice_d20",  "Dice_d20_adv",  "Dice_d20_dis", "Dice_Roll", "Dice_Fate", "Dice_Fate_4",
"Icon_Book", "Icon_Bow", "Icon_Character", "Icon_Checkmark", "Icon_Cloud", "Icon_Diamond", "Icon_Explosion", 
"Icon_Fire", "Icon_Fist", "Icon_Flag", "Icon_Gear", "Icon_Gun", "Icon_Heart", "Icon_HeartBroken", "Icon_Hourglass", 
"Icon_Key", "Icon_PawnDown", "Icon_PawnUp", "Icon_Plus", "Icon_Pointer", "Icon_Pouch", "Icon_Shield",
"Icon_Skull", "Icon_Star", "Icon_Sword", "Icon_Target", "Icon_Vial", "Icon_Wrench"}

function onload(saved_data)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Set roll target", setRollTarget)
    ready = true
    taken = {}
    local loaded_data = {}
    if (saved_data ~= "") then
        loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
    end
    rollData = loaded_data.rollData or {}

    updateDiceData()
    
    settings = loaded_data.settings or {
        buttonOffset={x=0,y=0},
        buttonWidth=200,
        grid={x=2,y=5},
        relativeTargetPosition={x=0,y=0,z=6},
        absoluteTargetPosition={x=self.getPosition().x,y=self.getPosition().y,z=self.getPosition().z+3},
        rollHeight=1,
        spread=3,
        rollPositionType="Relative",
        linkedGUIDs="",
        aliases={},
        mode="Basic",
        linkedSheet="",
        variablesLocked=true,
        promotedOnly=false,
        rollsLocked=false,
        switchResult=false,
        announceResult=true,
        displayResult=true,
        iconPanelOffset=true,
        verboseResult=false,
        visibility="All"
    }

    onModeChange(nil, settings.mode, 0, true)
    return 1
end

function onObjectLeaveContainer(container, object)
    if (container != self) then return false end
    dirty = true
end

function onObjectDrop(colorName, object)
    if (object == targetMarker) then
        Wait.time(function()
            changeTargetPosition(colorName)
        end, 1)
    end
end

function changeTargetPosition(color)
    if (targetMarker != nil) then
        Player[color].pingTable(targetMarker.getPosition())
        Player[color].broadcast("Dice roll target position set", "White")
        settings.absoluteTargetPosition = targetMarker.getPosition()
        local relativeOffset = targetMarker.getPosition()-self.getPosition()
        local forward = relativeOffset:dot(self.getTransformForward())
        local right = relativeOffset:dot(self.getTransformRight())
        local up = relativeOffset:dot(self.getTransformUp())
        settings.relativeTargetPosition = Vector(right, up, forward)
        destroyObject(targetMarker)
        updateSave()
        targetMarker = nil
    end
end

function setRollTarget(ply, object_position, object)
    if (targetMarker != nil) then
        destroyObject(targetMarker)
        ply.broadcast("Canceled", "White")
        targetMarker = nil
        return
    end
    ply.broadcast("Grab the token and place it where you want dice rolls to land", "White")
    local markerURL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2458480429345457739/4B52CB8CFA067900BA1C198D488591F9C277D34F/"
    targetMarker = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        position=add(self.getPosition(), Vector(0,3,0)),
        scale=Vector(0.4,0.4,0.4)
    })
    targetMarker.setName("▶ Place me where you want dice to land")
    targetMarker.setColorTint("Black")
    targetMarker.setCustomObject({
        image=markerURL,
        image_bottom=markerURL,
        type=2,
        thickness=0.2,
        stackable=false,
    })
end

function getObjectKeyFromObjectData(data)
    local objectKey = ""
    local rotValues = data.RotationValues
    local valueCount = #rotValues
    
    if (data.Nickname != "") then
        objectKey = "name:"..string.lower(data.Nickname)
    elseif (valueCount > 0) then
        local maxValue = -99999999
        local words = false
        for k, v in pairs(rotValues) do
            if (tonumber(v.Value) == nil) then
                words = true
            else
                if (tonumber(v.Value) > maxValue) then
                    maxValue = tonumber(v.Value)
                end
            end
        end
        if (words) then
            if (data.Nickname == "") then
                print("Dice thrower: Please give this object a name so I know how to select it")
                return nil
            else
                objectKey = "name:"..string.lower(data.Nickname)
            end
        else
            if (valueCount == 1) then
                objectKey = "const:"..maxValue
            else
                objectKey = "die:"..valueCount
            end
        end
    else
        print("Dice thrower: Inserted objects should have a name and/or rotation values")
        return nil
    end
    return objectKey
end

function updateDiceData()
    diceData = {}
    consts = {}
    local containedObjects = self.getData().ContainedObjects
    for _, containedObject in ipairs(containedObjects) do
        local objectKey = getObjectKeyFromObjectData(containedObject)
        containedObject.memo = objectKey
        diceData[objectKey] = containedObject
        if (string.find(objectKey,"const:")) then
            local spl = split(objectKey, ":")
            if (tonumber(spl[2]) != nil) then
                table.insert(consts, tonumber(spl[2]))
            end
        end
    end
    dirty = false
end

function tryObjectEnter(object)
    if (targetMarker == object) then return end
    if (dirty) then updateDiceData() end
    local data = object.getData()
    local objectKey = getObjectKeyFromObjectData(data)
    if (objectKey == nil) then return false end
    -- Object with that key already in bag, eject
    if (diceData[objectKey] != nil) then
        for k, v in pairs(self.getObjects()) do
            if (v.guid == diceData[objectKey].GUID) then
                self.takeObject({guid=v.guid, position=self.getPosition()+self.getTransformForward()*1.5+self.getTransformUp()})
                break
            end
        end
    end
    dirty = true
    return true
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {rollData=rollData, settings=settings}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function toggleEdit()
    configuringRollId = 0
    configuringMode = NORMAL
    editing = not editing
    if (not editing) then
        updateSave()
    end
    createUI()
end

function addMod(ply, value, id)
    if (dirty) then updateDiceData() end
    ply.showOptionsDialog("Add a modifier to the roll", {"Dont clear roll", "Keep highest", "Keep lowest", "Drop highest", "Drop lowest", "Proficiency as dice count", "1 additional dice", "Count ones", "Count sixes"},
    function(text, optionID, player_color)
        if (optionID == 1) then addToCurrentRoll("~NoClear", 1)
        elseif (optionID == 2) then addToCurrentRoll("~High", 1)
        elseif (optionID == 3) then addToCurrentRoll("~Low", 1)
        elseif (optionID == 4) then addToCurrentRoll("~dropHigh", 1)
        elseif (optionID == 5) then addToCurrentRoll("~dropLow", 1)
        elseif (optionID == 6) then addToCurrentRoll("~Prof", 1)
        elseif (optionID == 7) then addToCurrentRoll("~Add1Dice", 1)
        elseif (optionID == 8) then addToCurrentRoll("~Count1s", 1)
        elseif (optionID == 9) then addToCurrentRoll("~Count6s", 1) end
    end)
end

function addNamedObject(ply, value, id)
    if (dirty) then updateDiceData() end
    local options = {}
    for k, v in pairs(diceData) do
        local name = v.Nickname
        if (name != "") then
            table.insert(options,name)
        end
    end
    if (#options == 0)then
        ply.showInfoDialog("There are no named objects in the bag. Name an object and put it into the dice thrower.")
    else
        ply.showOptionsDialog("Choose an object.\nYou can add your own named objects to the bag.", options,
        function (text, index, player_color)
            ply.showInputDialog("How many do you want to roll?", "1",
            function(countText, player_color)
                local count = tonumber(countText)
                if (count == nil) then
                    broadcastToColor("Invalid count '"..text.."'", player_color)
                else
                    if (count > 0) then
                        for i=1, count do
                            addToCurrentRoll("("..text..")", 1)
                        end
                    elseif(count < 0) then
                        for i=1, math.abs(count) do
                            addToCurrentRoll("("..text..")", -1)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end

function setAliasName(ply, value, id, skipWarning)
    local spl = split(id,"/")
    local aliasID = tonumber(spl[2])
    if (not skipWarning and settings.mode == "Daggerheart" and string.find(string.lower(settings.aliases[aliasID].name), "prof")) then
        ply.showConfirmDialog("This variable is used for proficiency rolls in Daggerheart. Renaming it may disable proficiency rolls. Are you sure?",
        function(player_color)
            Wait.frames(function()
                setAliasName(ply, value, id, true)
            end,1)
        end)
    else
        local name = ""
        ply.showInputDialog("Set variable short name\n(button label)",
        settings.aliases[aliasID].name,
        function(text, player_color)
            name = text
            local tooltip = name
            if (settings.aliases[aliasID].name == name) then
                tooltip = settings.aliases[aliasID].tooltip
            end
            ply.showInputDialog("Set variable full name\n(button tooltip)",
            tooltip,
            function(text, player_color)
                settings.aliases[aliasID].name = name
                settings.aliases[aliasID].tooltip = text
                createUI()
                updateSave()
            end)
        end)
    end
end

    local changeValue = function()
        ply.showInputDialog("Set variable value",

        function(text, player_color)
            settings.aliases[aliasID].value = text
            settings.aliases[aliasID].linkedField = -1
            createUI()
            updateSave()

    if (settings.linkedSheet != nil and settings.linkedSheet != "") then
        ply.showConfirmDialog("This variable is linked to "..getObjectFromGUID(settings.linkedSheet).getName()..". Do you want to unlink it?",

    else

    local spl = split(id,"/")
    local aliasID = tonumber(spl[2])
    local delete = function() ply.showConfirmDialog("Delete "..settings.aliases[aliasID].name.."?",
        function(player_color)
            broadcastToColor(settings.aliases[aliasID].name.." deleted", player_color)
            table.remove(settings.aliases, aliasID)
            createUI()
            updateSave()
        end)
    end
    if (not skipWarning and settings.mode == "Daggerheart" and string.find(string.lower(settings.aliases[aliasID].name), "prof")) then
        ply.showConfirmDialog("This variable is used for proficiency rolls in Daggerheart. Renaming it will disable proficiency rolls.",
        function(player_color)
            Wait.frames(function()
                delete()
            end,1)
        end)
    else
        delete()
    end
end

function getButtonTextColor(rollID)
    local color = rollData[rollID].color
    local grayscale = 0.299*color.r + 0.587*color.g + 0.114*color.b
    if (grayscale > 0.5) then
        return "#000000"
    else
        return "#ffffff"
    end
end

function onSettingChangeAndRefresh(ply, value, id)
    onSettingChange(ply, value, id)
    createUI()
    updateSave()
end

function onSettingChange(ply, value, id)
    local spl = split(id, "/")
    if (#spl == 2) then
        if (value == "True") then
            value = true
        elseif (value == "False") then
            value = false
        end
        settings[spl[2]] = value
    else
        settings[spl[2]][spl[3]] = value
    end
    updateSave()
end

function onVisibilityChange(ply, option, id)
    settings.visibility = option
    createUI()
    updateSave()
end

function onModeChange(ply, option, id, ignoreAliases)
    settings.mode = option
    if (not ignoreAliases) then
        if (option == "DnD") then
            settings.aliases = {
                {name="STR", tooltip="Strength", value="0"},
                {name="DEX", tooltip="Dexterity", value="0"},
                {name="CON", tooltip="Constitution", value="0"},
                {name="INT", tooltip="Intelligence", value="0"},
                {name="WIS", tooltip="Wisdom", value="0"},
                {name="CHA", tooltip="Charisma", value="0"},
                {name="Prof", tooltip="Proficiency", value="2"} 
            }
        elseif (option == "Daggerheart" or option == "Daggerheart (v1.3)") then
            settings.aliases = {
                {name="AGI", tooltip="Agility", value="0"},
                {name="STR", tooltip="Strength", value="0"},
                {name="FIN", tooltip="Finesse", value="0"},
                {name="INS", tooltip="Instinct", value="0"},
                {name="PRE", tooltip="Presence", value="0"},
                {name="KNO", tooltip="Knowledge", value="0"},
                {name="Prof", tooltip="Proficiency", value="1"} 
            }
        else
            settings.aliases = {}
        end
    end
    createUI()
    updateSave()
end

    end

function updateCurrentRoll()
    checkForLinkedAliasUpdates(true)
    local validRoll = false
    for k, v in pairs(currentRoll) do
        validRoll = true
        break
    end
    currentRollString = ""
    requirement = ""
    suffix = ""
    if (validRoll) then
        for k, v in pairs(currentRoll) do
            if (k == "+1") then
                if (string.len(currentRollString) > 0) then
                    currentRollString = currentRollString.."+"..v
                else
                    currentRollString = currentRollString..v
                end
            elseif (k == "-1") then
                currentRollString = currentRollString.."-"..v
            elseif (string.sub(k, 1, 1) == "[") then
                if (v > 0 and string.len(currentRollString) > 0) then
                    currentRollString = currentRollString.."+"..k
                else
                    currentRollString = currentRollString..k
                end
            elseif (string.sub(k, 1, 1) == "~") then
                suffix = suffix..k
            elseif (string.sub(k, 1, 1) == ">") then
                currentRequirement = string.sub(k, 2, 1)
                requirement = k
            else
                if (v > 0 and string.len(currentRollString) > 0) then
                    currentRollString = currentRollString.."+"..v..k
                else
                    currentRollString = currentRollString..v..k
                end
            end
        end
        currentRollString = currentRollString..requirement..suffix
    end
    if (currentRollString != "") then
        self.UI.setAttribute("rollDisplay", "textColor", "#ffffff")
    else
        self.UI.setAttribute("rollDisplay", "textColor", "#333333")
    end
    self.UI.setAttribute("rollDisplay","text",currentRollString)
end

function addToCurrentRoll(add, sign)
    if (string.sub(add,1,1) == ">") then
        for k, v in pairs(currentRoll) do
            if (string.sub(k, 1, 1) == ">") then
                currentRoll[k] = nil
                break
            end
        end
        if (sign == 1) then
            currentRoll[add] = 1
        end
    elseif (string.sub(add,1,1) == "[" or string.sub(add,1,1) == "~") then
        if (sign == 1) then
            currentRoll[add] = 1
        else
            currentRoll[add] = nil
        end
    else
        if (sign == -1) then
            if (add == "+1" or add == "-1") then
                if (currentRoll[add] == nil or currentRoll[add] < 1) then
                    return false
                end
            end
        end
        if (currentRoll[add] == nil) then
            currentRoll[add] = sign
        else
            currentRoll[add] = currentRoll[add]+sign
            if (currentRoll[add] == 0) then
                currentRoll[add] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    updateCurrentRoll()
end
