function rollDiceCoroutine()
    clearCurrentRoll()
    if (rolling == "") then
        rolling = defaultRoll
    else
        defaultRoll = rolling
        self.UI.setAttribute("rollDisplay", "textColor", "#333333")
        self.UI.setAttribute("rollDisplay", "placeholder", defaultRoll)
    end
    local velocity = Vector(0, 0, 0)
    local offset = settings.relativeTargetPosition
    if (settings.rollPositionType == "Absolute") then
        local a = settings.absoluteTargetPosition
        offset = Vector(a.x,a.y,a.z)-self.getPosition()
    end
    local g = Physics.getGravity()
    local h = 0.25+settings.rollHeight/4
    velocity = Vector(offset.x/h-g.x*h, offset.y/h-g.y*h, offset.z/h-g.z*h)*0.68
    local spread = settings.spread/2
    local i = 0
    local parsedRoll = parseRollText(rolling)
    local currentRollData = parsedRoll.rollData
    local isAdditive = parsedRoll.isAdditive
    keepingHighest = parsedRoll.keepHighest
    keepingLowest = parsedRoll.keepLowest
    countingOnes = parsedRoll.countOnes
    countingSixes = parsedRoll.countSixes
    droppingHighest = parsedRoll.dropHighest
    droppingLowest = parsedRoll.dropLowest
    if (currentRollData == nil) then
        return 1
    end
    if (#currentRollData == 0) then
        coroutine.yield(0)
        Wait.stop(rollingWaitCondition)
        self.UI.hide("rollingThrobber")
    end
    ready = false
    if (not isAdditive and not alting) then
        removeDice()
    end
    local throws = #currentRollData
    if (settings.rollPositionType == "Relative") then
        velocity = add(self.getTransformRight()*velocity.x, add(self.getTransformUp()*velocity.y, self.getTransformForward()*velocity.z))
    end
    for k, v in pairs(currentRollData) do
        if (self.getQuantity() > 0) then
            local randomVelocity = Vector(velocity.x+math.random(-spread, spread), velocity.y+math.random(-spread, spread), velocity.z+math.random(-spread, spread))

            local spawnedObject = spawnObjectData({
                data=diceData[v.objectKey],
                position=add(self.getPosition(), Vector(0,1.5,0)),
                rotation=self.getRotation()+Vector(0,180,0)
            })
            table.insert(thrownDice, spawnedObject)
            if (canceling) then
                canceling = false
                return 1
            end
            coroutine.yield(0)
            if (canceling) then
                canceling = false
                return 1
            end
            coroutine.yield(0)
            while (spawnedObject == nil or (spawnedObject != nil and spawnedObject.loading_custom)) do
                if (canceling) then
                    canceling = false
                    return 1
                end
                coroutine.yield(0)
            end
            if not spawnedObject.isDestroyed() then
                if (v.forceName != nil) then
                    spawnedObject.setName(v.forceName)
                end
                if (v.append != nil) then
                    spawnedObject.setName(spawnedObject.getName()..v.append)
                end
                spawnedObject.randomize()
                spawnedObject.setVelocity(randomVelocity)
                if (v.sign == -1) then
                    local invertedRotationValues = spawnedObject.getRotationValues()
                    for kk, vv in pairs(invertedRotationValues) do
                        vv.value = -vv.value
                    end
                    spawnedObject.setRotationValues(invertedRotationValues)
                end
                if (rollHidden) then
                    local allPlayers = Player.getColors()
                    local invisibleTo = {}
                    for k, v in pairs(allPlayers) do
                        if (v != rollingPlayer.color and v != "Black") then
                            table.insert(invisibleTo, v)
                        end
                    end
                    spawnedObject.setInvisibleTo(invisibleTo)
                end
            end
        end
        local frames = 6
        while (frames > 0) do
            if (canceling) then
                canceling = false
                return 1
            end
            frames = frames - 1
            coroutine.yield(0)
        end
    end
    ready = true
    if (#queuedRolls > 0) then
        rollDice(queuedRolls[1], true)
        table.remove(queuedRolls, 1)
    end
    return 1
end

function add(a, b)
    return {x=a.x+b.x, y=a.y+b.y, z=a.z+b.z}
end

function parseRollText(inputText)
    local safety = 100
    local rollData = {}
    if (string.sub(inputText, 1, 1) == "~") then
        return rollData
    end
    local isAdditive = false
    local text = inputText
    for k, v in pairs(settings.aliases) do
        local value = tostring(v.value)
        local sanitisedAlias = value:gsub("-", "–")
        sanitisedAlias = sanitisedAlias:gsub("+", "")
        text = text:gsub("{"..v.name.."}", "("..sanitisedAlias..")")
    end
    if (string.sub(text, 1, 1) ~= "-") then
        text = "+"..text
    end
    local rollText = text
    local suffixSplit = split(text, "~")
    local requirement = ""
    currentRequirement = nil
    if (not string.match(text, "~")) then
        if (string.match(text, ">")) then
            local requirementSplit = split(text, ">")
            rollText = requirementSplit[1]
            requirement = requirementSplit[2]
        else
            rollText = suffixSplit[1]
        end
    else
        if (string.match(text, ">")) then
            local requirementSplit = split(text, ">")
            if (string.match(text, "~")) then
                requirementSplit = split(suffixSplit[1], ">")
            end
            rollText = requirementSplit[1]
            requirement = requirementSplit[2]
        else
            rollText = suffixSplit[1]
        end
    end
    if (requirement != "") then
        currentRequirement = tonumber(string.sub(requirement, 1, -1))
    end
    local useProf = false
    local oneAdditionalDice = false
    local keepHighest = false
    local keepLowest = false
    local dropHighest = false
    local dropLowest = false
    local countOnes = false
    local countSixes = false
    for k, v in pairs(suffixSplit) do
        if (v == "Prof") then
            useProf = true
        elseif (v == "Add1Dice") then
            oneAdditionalDice = true
        elseif (v == "NoClear") then
            isAdditive = true
        elseif (v == "High") then
            keepHighest = true
        elseif (v == "Low") then
            keepLowest = true
        elseif (v == "dropHigh") then
            dropHighest = true
        elseif (v == "dropLow") then
            dropLowest = true
        elseif (v == "Count1s") then
            countOnes = true
        elseif (v == "Count6s") then
            countSixes = true
        end
    end
    for str in string.gmatch(rollText, "([+-][^+-]+)") do
        local str = str:gsub("–", "-")
        local amount = 1
        local sign = 1
        if (string.sub(str, 1, 1) == "-") then
            sign = -1
        end
        -- Multiply in parenthesis
        if (string.sub(str,-1) == ")") then
            local rollSplit = split(str, "(")
            if (#rollSplit == 2) then
                amount = tonumber(rollSplit[1])
                if (amount != nil) then
                    count = amount
                    str = string.sub(rollSplit[2], 1, -2)
                end
                if (amount > 0) then
                    str = "+"..str
                else
                    str = "-"..str
                end
            end
        end
        if (string.sub(str, 1, 1) == "+") then
            str = string.sub(str, 2)
        end
        for amo=1, math.abs(amount) do
            if (string.sub(str,1,1) == "[" and string.sub(str,-1) == "]") then
                --Its a special roll
                if (amount > safety) then
                    broadcastToColor("Roll too big!", rollingPlayer.color, "Red")
                    return {}
                else
                    safety = safety - amount
                end
                local special = string.sub(str,2,-2)
                special = string.lower(special)
                if (string.find(special, "dual") and string.find(special, "dis")) then
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:hope", sign=sign, forceName="Hope Disadvantage"})
                elseif (string.find(special, "dual") and string.find(special, "adv")) then
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:hope", sign=sign, forceName="Hope Advantage"})
                elseif (string.find(special, "dual")) then
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:fear", sign=sign, forceName="Fear"})
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:hope", sign=sign, forceName="Hope"})
                elseif (string.find(special, "dis")) then
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="die:20", sign=sign, append="disadvantage"})
                elseif (string.find(special, "adv")) then
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="die:20", sign=sign, append="advantage"})
                elseif (string.find(special, "d100")) then
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:tens", sign=1})
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:ones", sign=1})
                elseif (string.find(special, "fate")) then
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:fate", sign=1})
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:fate", sign=1})
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:fate", sign=1})
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:fate", sign=1})
                end
                
            else
                local diceSplit = split(str, "dD")
                local hasD = false
                if (string.match(str, "[dD]")) then
                    hasD = true
                end
                local number = tonumber(str)
                if (number != nil) then
                    --Its a constant number
                    if (number > 0) then
                        while (number > 0) do
                            local highestValidConst = 0
                            for k, v in pairs(consts) do
                                if (v <= number and v > highestValidConst) then
                                    highestValidConst = v
                                end
                            end
                            local const = "const:"..highestValidConst
                            table.insert(rollData, {objectKey=const, sign=sign})
                            number = number-highestValidConst
                            safety = safety - 1
                            if (safety <= 0) then
                                broadcastToColor("Couldn't make roll with the values in the bag", rollingPlayer.color, "Red")
                                return {}
                            end
                        end
                    elseif (number < 0) then
                        while (number < 0) do
                            local lowestValidConst = 0
                            for k, v in pairs(consts) do
                                if (v >= number and v < lowestValidConst) then
                                    lowestValidConst = v
                                end
                            end
                            local const = "const:"..lowestValidConst
                            table.insert(rollData, {objectKey=const, sign=1})
                            number = number-lowestValidConst
                            safety = safety - 1
                            if (safety <= 0) then
                                broadcastToColor("Couldn't make roll with the values in the bag", rollingPlayer.color, "Red")
                                return {}
                            end
                        end
                    elseif (number == 0) then
                        if (diceData["const:0"] != nil) then
                            table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="const:0", sign=sign})
                            safety = safety - 1
                            if (safety <= 0) then
                                broadcastToColor("Roll too big!", rollingPlayer.color, "Red")
                                return {}
                            end
                        end
                    end    
                elseif (not useProf and (hasD and #diceSplit == 2 and tonumber(diceSplit[1]) != nil and tonumber(diceSplit[2]) != nil)) then
                    local count = math.abs(tonumber(diceSplit[1]))
                    local denomination = tonumber(diceSplit[2])
                    if (oneAdditionalDice) then
                        count = count+1
                    end
                    if (count*amount > safety) then
                        broadcastToColor("Roll too big!", rollingPlayer.color, "Red")
                        return {}
                    else
                        safety = safety - count*amount
                    end
                    if (count != nil and denomination != nil) then
                        --Its a dice roll
                        for i=1, count do
                            table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="die:"..denomination, sign=sign})
                        end
                    end
                elseif (hasD and #diceSplit == 1 and tonumber(diceSplit[1])) then
                    --Proficiency roll
                    local count = 1
                    for k, v in pairs(settings.aliases) do
                        if (string.find(string.lower(v.name), "prof")) then
                            count = tonumber(v.value)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if (oneAdditionalDice) then
                        count = count+1
                    end
                    local denomination = tonumber(diceSplit[1])
                    if ((count or 1) > safety) then
                        broadcastToColor("Roll too big!", rollingPlayer.color, "Red")
                        return {}
                    else
                        safety = safety - (count or 1)
                    end
                    if (count != nil and denomination != nil) then
                        --Its a dice roll
                        for i=1, count do
                            table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="die:"..denomination, sign=sign})
                        end
                    end
                elseif (useProf and ((#diceSplit == 1 and tonumber(diceSplit[1])) or #diceSplit == 2 and tonumber(diceSplit[1]) and tonumber(diceSplit[2]))) then
                    --Proficiency roll
                    local count = 1
                    if (#diceSplit == 2) then
                        count = tonumber(diceSplit[1])
                    end
                    for k, v in pairs(settings.aliases) do
                        if (string.find(string.lower(v.name), "prof")) then
                            count = count * tonumber(v.value)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if (oneAdditionalDice) then
                        count = count+1
                    end
                    local denomination = tonumber(diceSplit[1])
                    if (#diceSplit == 2) then
                        denomination = tonumber(diceSplit[2])
                    end
                    if ((count or 1) > safety) then
                        broadcastToColor("Roll too big!", rollingPlayer.color, "Red")
                        return {}
                    else
                        safety = safety - (count or 1)
                    end
                    if (count != nil and denomination != nil) then
                        --Its a dice roll
                        for i=1, count do
                            table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="die:"..denomination, sign=sign})
                        end
                    end
                else
                    --Its a named roll
                    table.insert(rollData, {objectKey="name:"..string.lower(str), sign=sign})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return {rollData=rollData, isAdditive=isAdditive, keepHighest=keepHighest, keepLowest=keepLowest, dropHighest=dropHighest, dropLowest=dropLowest, countOnes=countOnes, countSixes=countSixes}
end

function split (inputstr, sep)
    if sep == nil then
            sep = "%s"
    end
    local t={}
    for str in string.gmatch(inputstr, "([^"..sep.."]+)") do
            table.insert(t, str)
    end
    return t
end

-- RESULT DISPLAY
function updateDisplay()
    local result = 0
    local words = {}
    local hope = 0
    local fear = 0
    local highest = -1000
    local lowest = 1000
    local resting = true
    local advantage = false
    local disadvantage = false
    local disadvantageValue = 0
    local advantageValue = 0
    local hopeadvantage = 0
    local hopedisadvantage = 0
    local natural20 = false
    local d20Count = 0
    local d20 = 0
    local bonus = 0
    local constants = 0

    local ones = 0
    local sixes = 0

    local hits = 0
    local misses = 0

    local individualResults = {}

    local dice = false
    local d100Ones = false
    local d100Tens = false

    local function checkIfHitOrMiss(value)
        if (currentRequirement != nil and currentRequirement != "") then
            if (value >= currentRequirement) then
                hits = hits+1
            else
                misses = misses+1
            end
        end
    end

    self.UI.setValue("dualityResult", "")
    for k, v in pairs(thrownDice) do
        if (not v.getLock()) then
            if (v.getValue() != nil) then
                local rotValue = v.getRotationValue()
                local name = string.lower(v.getName())
                
                if (string.find(name, "hope") and string.find(name, "disadv")) then
                    hopedisadvantage = hopedisadvantage + rotValue
                elseif (string.find(name, "hope") and string.find(name, "adv")) then
                    hopeadvantage = hopeadvantage + rotValue
                elseif (string.find(name, "hope")) then
                    hope = hope + rotValue
                    result = result + rotValue
                    table.insert(individualResults, rotValue)
                    checkIfHitOrMiss(rotValue)
                    dice = true
                elseif (string.find(name, "fear")) then
                    fear = fear + rotValue
                    result = result + rotValue
                    table.insert(individualResults, rotValue)
                    checkIfHitOrMiss(rotValue)
                    dice = true
                elseif (string.find(name, "disadv")) then
                    disadvantage = true
                    disadvantageValue = rotValue
                    table.insert(individualResults, rotValue)
                    checkIfHitOrMiss(rotValue)
                elseif (string.find(name, "adv")) then
                    advantage = true
                    advantageValue = rotValue
                    table.insert(individualResults, rotValue)
                    checkIfHitOrMiss(rotValue)
                else
                    if (string.find(string.lower(name), "tens")) then d100Tens = true end
                    if (string.find(string.lower(name), "ones")) then d100Ones = true end
                    if (tonumber(rotValue)) then
                        result = result + rotValue
                        if (#v.getRotationValues() > 1) then
                            highest = math.max(tonumber(rotValue), highest)
                            lowest = math.min(tonumber(rotValue), lowest)
                            if (tonumber(rotValue) == 1) then
                                ones = ones+1
                            elseif (tonumber(rotValue) == 6) then
                                sixes = sixes+1
                            end
                        end
                        table.insert(individualResults, rotValue)
                        checkIfHitOrMiss(rotValue)
                    else
                        if (words[rotValue] == nil) then
                            words[rotValue] = 1
                        else
                            words[rotValue] = words[rotValue]+1
                        end
                    end
                    if (#v.getRotationValues() == 20) then
                        d20 = rotValue
                        d20Count = d20Count+1
                        if (d20Count == 1 and rotValue == 20) then
                            natural20 = true
                        else
                            natural20 = false
                        end
                    else
                        if (tonumber(rotValue)) then
                            if (#v.getRotationValues() == 1) then
                                constants = constants + rotValue
                            else
                                dice = true
                            end
                            bonus = bonus + rotValue
                        end
                    end
                end
                if (not v.resting)then
                    resting = false
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local dualityResult = ""
    local alternativeResult = ""
    self.UI.setValue("advantageDisplay", "")
    if (hope > 0 and fear > 0 and resting) then
        if (hopedisadvantage > 0) then
            if (hopedisadvantage < hope) then
                if (hope == fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "CRIT"
                end
                if (hope > fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "w/Hope"
                end
                if (hope < fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "w/Fear"
                end
                alternativeResult = "(lost "..result.." "..alternateDuality..")"
                result = result-hope+hopedisadvantage
                hope = hopedisadvantage
            else
                local alternateDuality = ""
                if (hopedisadvantage == fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "CRIT"
                end
                if (hopedisadvantage > fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "w/Hope"
                end
                if (hopedisadvantage < fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "w/Fear"
                end
                alternativeResult = "(lost "..(result-hope+hopedisadvantage).." "..alternateDuality..")"
            end
        end

        if (hopeadvantage > 0) then
            if (hopeadvantage == fear or (hopeadvantage > hope and hope != fear)) then
                if (hope == fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "CRIT"
                end
                if (hope > fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "w/Hope"
                end
                if (hope < fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "w/Fear"
                end
                alternativeResult = "(or "..result.." "..alternateDuality..")"
                result = result-hope+hopeadvantage
                hope = hopeadvantage
            else
                local alternateDuality = ""
                if (hopeadvantage == fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "CRIT"
                end
                if (hopeadvantage > fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "w/Hope"
                end
                if (hopeadvantage < fear) then
                    alternateDuality = "w/Fear"
                end
                alternativeResult = "(or "..(result-hope+hopeadvantage).." "..alternateDuality..")"
            end
        end

        if (hope == fear) then
            dualityResult = "CRIT!"
        end
        if (hope > fear) then
            dualityResult = "w/Hope"
        end
        if (hope < fear) then
            dualityResult = "w/Fear"
        end
    end
    if (d100Tens and d100Ones and result == 0) then
        result = 100
    end

    if (keepingHighest) then
        for k, v in pairs(thrownDice) do
            if (v.getValue() != nil) then
                if (#v.getRotationValues() > 1) then
                    v.highlightOn({r=1, g=0, b=0}, 5)
                end
            end
        end
        for k, v in pairs(thrownDice) do
            if (v.getValue() != nil) then
                if (#v.getRotationValues() > 1) then
                    if (v.getValue() == highest) then
                        v.highlightOn({r=0, g=1, b=0}, 5)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        result = highest + constants
    elseif (keepingLowest) then
        for k, v in pairs(thrownDice) do
            if (v.getValue() != nil) then
                if (#v.getRotationValues() > 1) then
                    v.highlightOn({r=1, g=0, b=0}, 5)
                end
            end
        end
        for k, v in pairs(thrownDice) do
            if (v.getValue() != nil) then
                if (#v.getRotationValues() > 1) then
                    if (v.getValue() == lowest) then
                        v.highlightOn({r=0, g=1, b=0}, 5)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        result = lowest + constants
    end
    if (droppingLowest) then
        for k, v in pairs(thrownDice) do
            if (v.getValue() != nil) then
                if (#v.getRotationValues() > 1) then
                    v.highlightOn({r=0, g=1, b=0}, 5)
                end
            end
        end
        for k, v in pairs(thrownDice) do
            if (v.getValue() != nil) then
                if (#v.getRotationValues() > 1) then
                    if (v.getValue() == lowest) then
                        v.highlightOn({r=1, g=0, b=0}, 5)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        result = result - lowest
    end
    if (droppingHighest) then
        for k, v in pairs(thrownDice) do
            if (v.getValue() != nil) then
                if (#v.getRotationValues() > 1) then
                    v.highlightOn({r=0, g=1, b=0}, 5)
                end
            end
        end
        for k, v in pairs(thrownDice) do
            if (v.getValue() != nil) then
                if (#v.getRotationValues() > 1) then
                    if (v.getValue() == highest) then
                        v.highlightOn({r=1, g=0, b=0}, 5)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        result = result - highest
    end
    if (keepingHighest and keepingLowest) then
        broadcastToAll("What do you mean 'keep highest' but also 'keep lowest'?")
    end
    if (keepingHighest and droppingHighest) then
        broadcastToAll("What do you mean 'keep highest' but also 'drop highest'?")
    end
    if (keepingLowest and droppingLowest) then
        broadcastToAll("What do you mean 'keep lowest' but also 'drop lowest'?")
    end

    if (advantage) then
        highest = math.max(advantageValue, d20)
        lowest = math.min(advantageValue, d20)
        result = highest+bonus
        removeByValue(individualResults, lowest)
        if (math.max(advantageValue, d20) == 20) then
            natural20 = true
        end
        alternativeResult = "("..(lowest)..", "..(highest)..")"
        self.UI.setAttributes("advantageDisplay", {
            text="Advantage",
            color="#80dd80"
        })
    elseif (disadvantage) then
        highest = math.max(disadvantageValue, d20)
        lowest = math.min(disadvantageValue, d20)
        result = lowest+bonus
        removeByValue(individualResults, highest)
        if (math.min(disadvantageValue, d20) == 20) then
            natural20 = true
        else
            natural20 = false
        end
        alternativeResult = "("..(lowest)..", "..(highest)..")"
        self.UI.setAttributes("advantageDisplay", {
            text="Disadvantage",
            color="#dd8080"
        })
    end

    if (not rollHidden and settings.displayResult) then
        if (result != "") then
            if (currentRequirement == nil) then
                local wordCount = 0
                for k, v in pairs(words) do
                    wordCount = wordCount+1
                end
                if (wordCount == 0) then
                    self.UI.show("result")
                    self.UI.setValue("result", result)
                else
                    local wordStr = ""
                    local i = 0
                    for k, v in pairs(words) do
                        if (i > 0) then
                            if (i == wordCount-1) then
                                wordStr = wordStr.." and "
                            else
                                wordStr = wordStr..", "
                            end
                        end
                        i = i+1
                        if (wordCount == 1 and v == 1) then
                            wordStr = wordStr..k
                        else
                            wordStr = wordStr..v.." "..k
                        end
                        first = false
                    end
                    self.UI.show("wordsResult")

                    if (countingOnes) then
                        wordStr = wordStr.." ("..ones.." ones)"
                    end
                    if (countingSixes) then
                        wordStr = wordStr.." ("..sixes.." sixes)"
                    end

                    if (dice) then
                        self.UI.setValue("wordsResult", result.." with "..wordStr)
                    else
                        self.UI.setValue("wordsResult", wordStr)
                    end
                end
            else
                self.UI.show("wordsResult")
                local hitStr = " successes"
                if (hits == 1) then
                    hitStr = " success"
                end
                local missStr = " misses"
                if (misses == 1) then
                    missStr = " miss"
                end
                local wordStr = ""
                if (countingOnes) then
                    wordStr = wordStr.." ("..ones.." ones)"
                end
                if (countingSixes) then
                    wordStr = wordStr.." ("..sixes.." sixes)"
                end

                if (hits > 0) then
                    if (misses > 0) then
                        self.UI.setValue("wordsResult", hits..hitStr..", "..misses..missStr.." ["..currentRequirement.."+]"..wordStr)
                    else
                        self.UI.setValue("wordsResult", hits..hitStr.." ["..currentRequirement.."+]"..wordStr)
                    end
                else
                    self.UI.setValue("wordsResult", misses..missStr.." ["..currentRequirement.."+]"..wordStr)
                end
            end
        end
        if (natural20) then
            if (advantage) then
                self.UI.show("advantageDisplay")
                self.UI.show("alternativeResult")
                self.UI.setValue("alternativeResult", "Nat 20! ("..(lowest)..", "..(highest)..")")
            elseif (disadvantage) then
                self.UI.show("advantageDisplay")
                self.UI.show("alternativeResult")
                self.UI.setValue("alternativeResult", "Nat 20! ("..(lowest)..", "..(highest)..")")
            else
                self.UI.show("dualityResult")
                self.UI.setValue("dualityResult", "Natural 20!")
            end
        else
            if (alternativeResult != "") then
                self.UI.show("alternativeResult")
                self.UI.setValue("alternativeResult", alternativeResult)
                if (dualityResult != "") then
                    self.UI.show("advantageDisplay")
                    self.UI.setAttributes("advantageDisplay", {
                        text=dualityResult,
                        color="White"
                    })
                end
            else
                if (dualityResult != "") then
                    self.UI.show("dualityResult")
                    self.UI.setValue("dualityResult", dualityResult)
                end
            end
            if (advantage or disadvantage) then
                self.UI.show("advantageDisplay")
            end
        end
    end

    if (settings.announceResult) then
        local announcement = ""
        local append = ": "
        if (rollingLabel != "") then
            append = " "..rollingLabel..": "
        end
        if (currentRequirement == nil) then
            local verboseResult = ""
            if (settings.verboseResult) then
                if (#individualResults > 1) then
                    if (keepingHighest) then
                        if (constants == 0) then
                            verboseResult = "(highest): "
                        elseif(constants > 0) then
                            verboseResult = "(highest, "..highest.."+"..constants.."): "
                        else
                            verboseResult = "(highest, "..highest..constants.."): "
                        end
                    elseif (keepingLowest) then
                        if (constants == 0) then
                            verboseResult = "(lowest): "
                        elseif(constants > 0) then
                            verboseResult = "(lowest, "..lowest.."+"..constants.."): "
                        else
                            verboseResult = "(lowest, "..lowest..constants.."): "
                        end
                    else
                        verboseResult = table.concat(individualResults,"+")
                        verboseResult = string.gsub(verboseResult, "%+%-", "-")
                        verboseResult = verboseResult.." = "
                    end
                    append = " "..verboseResult
                    if (rollingLabel != "") then
                        append = " "..rollingLabel..": ".." "..verboseResult
                    end
                end
            end
            if (countingOnes) then
                result = result.." ("..ones.." ones)"
            end
            if (countingSixes) then
                result = result.." ("..sixes.." sixes)"
            end
            announcement = rollingPlayer.steam_name.." rolled"..append..result
            if (natural20) then

            else
                if (dualityResult != "") then
                    announcement = announcement.." ("..dualityResult..")"
                    if (alternativeResult != "") then
                        announcement = announcement.. " ... "..alternativeResult
                    end
                end
                if (advantage) then
                    announcement = announcement.." ("..(lowest).." & "..(highest).." at advantage)"
                end
                if (disadvantage) then
                    announcement = announcement.." ("..(lowest).." & "..(highest).." at disadvantage)"
                end
            end
            local wordCount = 0
            for k, v in pairs(words) do
                wordCount = wordCount+1
            end
            if (wordCount > 0) then
                local wordStr = ""
                local i = 0
                for k, v in pairs(words) do
                    if (i > 0) then
                        if (i == wordCount-1) then
                            wordStr = wordStr.." and "
                        else
                            wordStr = wordStr..", "
                        end
                    end
                    i = i+1
                    if (wordCount == 1 and v == 1) then
                        wordStr = wordStr..k
                    else
                        wordStr = wordStr..v.." "..k
                    end
                    first = false
                end
                if (dice) then
                    announcement = announcement.." with "..wordStr
                else
                    announcement = rollingPlayer.steam_name.." rolled"..append..wordStr
                end
            end
        else
            local hitStr = " successes"
            if (hits == 1) then
                hitStr = " success"
            end
            local missStr = " misses"
            if (misses == 1) then
                missStr = " miss"
            end
            local verboseDescription = ""
            if (settings.verboseResult) then
                if (string.find(currentRollString, "~")) then
                    local spl = split(currentRollString, "~")
                    verboseDescription = " ("..spl[1]..")"
                else
                    verboseDescription = " ("..currentRollString..")"
                end
                verboseDescription = string.gsub(verboseDescription, ">", "⇒")
                append = verboseDescription..": "
                if (rollingLabel != "") then
                    append = " "..rollingLabel..verboseDescription..": "
                end
            end
            if (hits > 0) then
                if (misses > 0) then
                    announcement = rollingPlayer.steam_name.." rolled"..append..hits..hitStr..", "..misses..missStr.." [Needed "..currentRequirement.."+]"
                else
                    announcement = rollingPlayer.steam_name.." rolled"..append..hits..hitStr.." [Needed "..currentRequirement.."+]"
                end
            else
                announcement = rollingPlayer.steam_name.." rolled"..append..misses..missStr.." [Needed "..currentRequirement.."+]"
            end
            if (countingOnes) then
                announcement = announcement.." ("..ones.." ones)"
            end
            if (countingSixes) then
                announcement = announcement.." ("..sixes.." sixes)"
            end
        end
        if (rollHidden) then
            if (CheckPlayerColorInUse("Black")) then
                broadcastToColor("[Hidden] "..announcement, "Black")
            end
            if (rollingPlayer.color != "Black") then
                broadcastToColor("[Hidden] "..announcement, rollingPlayer.color)
            end
        else
            broadcastToAll(announcement, rollingPlayer.color)
        end
    end

    if (settings.autoCleanup) then
        autoCleanupWait = Wait.time(function()
            removeDice()
            self.UI.hide("result")
            self.UI.hide("wordsResult")
            self.UI.hide("alternativeResult")
            self.UI.hide("dualityResult")
            self.UI.hide("advantageDisplay")
            self.UI.hide("rollingThrobber")
        end, 5)
    end
end

function removeByValue(tbl, value)
    for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
        if (v == value) then
            table.remove(tbl, k)
            break
        end
    end
end

function add(a, b)
    return {x=a.x+b.x, y=a.y+b.y, z=a.z+b.z}
end

function null()
end

function linkSheet(ply, value, id)
    linkingInProgress = ply.color
    broadcastToColor("Ping the Editable Sheet you want to link to (mouse over and press TAB)", ply.color)
end

function unlinkSheet(ply, value, id)
    local name = "[Missing Object]"
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(settings.linkedSheet)
    if (obj != nil) then
        name = obj.getName()
    end
    ply.showConfirmDialog("Are you sure you want to unlink the dice roller from "..name, function()
        settings.linkedSheet = ""
        for k, v in pairs(settings.aliases) do
            v.linkedField = -1
        end
        broadcastToColor("Sheet unlinked", ply.color)
        createUI()
        updateSave()
    end)
end

function importVariablesFromObject(object)
    if (object.getGUID() != settings.linkedSheet) then
        local json = JSON.decode(object.getGMNotes())
        local newAliases = {}
        if (json.universalDiceRollerData.fields != nil) then
            local inputs = object.getInputs()
            for k, v in pairs(json.universalDiceRollerData.fields) do
                table.insert(newAliases, {
                    name=v[1],
                    tooltip=v[2],
                    value=inputs[tonumber(v[3])].value,
                    linkedField=v[3]
                })
            end
        end
        if (json.universalDiceRollerData.checks != nil) then
            local buttons = object.getButtons()
            for k, v in pairs(json.universalDiceRollerData.checks) do
                local rangeMin = tonumber(v[3])
                local rangeMax = tonumber(v[4])
                local onCharacter = v[5]
                local add = tonumber(v[6])
                local onCount = 0
                for i=rangeMin, rangeMax do
                    if (buttons[i].label == onCharacter) then
                        onCount = onCount+1
                    end
                end
                table.insert(newAliases, {
                    name=v[1],
                    tooltip=v[2],
                    value=tostring(onCount + add or 0),
                    linkedField=0,
                    rangeMin=rangeMin,
                    rangeMax=rangeMax,
                    onCharacter=onCharacter,
                    add=add
                })
            end
        end
        configuringAliases = false
        settings.aliases = newAliases
        settings.linkedSheet = object.getGUID()
        createUI()
        updateSave()
    end
end

function onPlayerPing(ply, pos, object)
    if (linkingInProgress == nil) then return end
    if (linkingInProgress == ply.color) then
        if (object == nil) then
            broadcastToColor("Object not found (make sure the object is unlocked). Canceling link.", ply.color)
            linkingInProgress = nil
        else
            local linkingData = JSON.decode(object.script_state)
            if (linkingData == nil) then
                broadcastToColor("This object has no script. Canceling link.", ply.color)
                linkingInProgress = nil
            else
                if (linkingData.checks != nil and linkingData.fields != nil and linkingData.decals != nil) then
                    settings.linkedSheet = object.getGUID()
                    if (object.getGMNotes() != "") then
                        local json = JSON.decode(object.getGMNotes())
                        if (json != nil) then
                            if (json.universalDiceRollerData != nil) then
                                ply.showConfirmDialog("This object has data for the Universal Dice Roller. Would you like to automatically import it?(This will override the current variables)", function()
                                    importVariablesFromObject(object)
                                    linkingInProgress = nil
                                    broadcastToColor("Data imported", ply.color)                
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    broadcastToColor("Successfully linked the dice roller to "..object.getName(), ply.color)
                    self.UI.hide("linkSheet")
                    self.UI.show("unlinkSheet")
                    self.UI.show("linkAlias")
                    updateSave()
                    linkingInProgress = nil
                else
                    broadcastToColor("Linking only works for sheets made with the 'Make Anything Editable' stamp.", ply.color)
                    broadcastToColor("Sheet is not compatible", ply.color)
                    linkingInProgress = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function linkAlias(ply, value, id)
    local object = getObjectFromGUID(settings.linkedSheet)
    if (object == nil) then
        broadcastToColor("Linked object is missing", ply.color)
        return false
    end
    local data = JSON.decode(object.script_state)
    local aliases = settings.aliases

    local aliasOptions = {}
    for k, v in pairs(aliases) do
        table.insert(aliasOptions, v.tooltip)
    end
    ply.showOptionsDialog("Select a variable to link", aliasOptions,
    function (text, aliasID, player_color)
        local fieldOptions = {}
        for k, v in pairs(data.fields) do
            local name = v.name or "Field #"..k
            table.insert(fieldOptions, name)
        end
        table.insert(fieldOptions,"<Unlink>")

        local column = 0
        local row = 0

        ply.showOptionsDialog("Select a field to link "..aliases[aliasID].tooltip.." to", fieldOptions,
        function (text, fieldID, player_color)
            if (text == "<Unlink>") then -- Unlink
                aliases[aliasID].linkedField = -1
                broadcastToColor("Unlinked "..aliases[aliasID].tooltip, player_color)
                createUI()
                updateSave()
            else
                local finish = function()
                    local name = data.fields[fieldID].name or "Field #"..fieldID
                    local columnText = ""
                    if (column > 0) then
                        columnText = ", column "..column
                    else
                        column = 1
                    end
                    local rowText = ""
                    if (row > 0) then
                        rowText = ", row "..row
                    else
                        row = 1
                    end
                    local inputID = 0
                    for i=1, fieldID-1 do
                        inputID = inputID+data.fields[i].array.x*data.fields[i].array.y
                    end
                    inputID = inputID+(column-1)*data.fields[fieldID].array.y+(row-1)+1
                    aliases[aliasID].linkedField = inputID
                    broadcastToColor("Linked "..aliases[aliasID].tooltip.." to "..name..columnText..rowText, player_color)
                    createUI()
                    updateSave()
                end

                local field = data.fields[fieldID]
                local chooseColumn = function(callback)
                    local o = {}
                    for i=1, tonumber(field.array.x) do
                        table.insert(o, i)
                    end
                    ply.showOptionsDialog("Column", o,
                    function(text, columnID, player_color)
                        column = columnID
                        if (callback != nil) then
                            callback()
                        else
                            finish()
                        end
                    end)
                end
                
                local chooseRow = function(callback)
                    local o = {}
                    for i=1, tonumber(field.array.y) do
                        table.insert(o, i)
                    end
                    ply.showOptionsDialog("Row", o,
                    function(text, rowID, player_color)
                        row = rowID
                        if (callback != nil) then
                            callback()
                        else
                            finish()
                        end
                    end)
                end

                if (tonumber(field.array.x) > 1) then
                    if (tonumber(field.array.y) > 1) then
                        chooseColumn(chooseRow)
                    else
                        chooseColumn()
                    end
                else
                    if (tonumber(field.array.y) > 1) then
                        chooseRow()
                    else
                        finish()
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
end

function checkForLinkedAliasUpdates(updateIfDirty)
    if (settings.linkedSheet != nil and settings.linkedSheet != "") then
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(settings.linkedSheet)
        if (obj == nil) then
            settings.linkedSheet = ""
        else
            local inputs = obj.getInputs()
            local buttons = obj.getButtons()
            local dirtyAlias = false
            for k, v in pairs(settings.aliases) do
                if (v.linkedField != nil and v.linkedField >= 0) then
                    if (v.onCharacter != nil) then
                        if (buttons != nil) then
                            local onCount = 0
                            for i=v.rangeMin, v.rangeMax do
                                if (buttons[i].label == v.onCharacter) then
                                    onCount = onCount+1
                                end
                            end
                            if (v.add != nil) then
                                onCount = onCount + v.add
                            end
                            if (onCount != v.value) then
                                v.value = onCount
                                dirtyAlias = true
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        if (inputs != nil) then
                            if (inputs[v.linkedField].value != v.value) then
                                v.value = inputs[v.linkedField].value
                                dirtyAlias = true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if (updateIfDirty and dirtyAlias) then
                createUI()
                updateSave()
            end
        end
    end
end

function CheckPlayerColorInUse(targetColor)
    local players = Player.getPlayers()
    for _, player in pairs(players) do
        if player.seated then
            if player.color == targetColor then
                return true -- The color is in use
            end
        end
    end
    return false -- The color is not in use

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,

})

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05

    self.addAttachment(child)

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 4
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_4"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end     local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)

    name_update()
end

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 4
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_4"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end
