    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

function getMissileImgPath(level)

    elseif level == 3 then

    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then

    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)

        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()

        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG

function getResImgPath()

        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

    prepToken()

    prepToken()

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Token
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/958597478463059274/DE73B64E1B5C6F272EA3BEE5EF458E73E48FF03D/
label = "HQ Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,100}

min_val = 0
val = self.getName()
max_val = self.getDescription()

if not val then
  val = 10
end
if not max_val then
  max_val = 20
end

function name_update()
  self.setName(val)
  self.setDescription(max_val)
  self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
end

self.createButton({
  tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
  click_function = "increment_val",
  function_owner = self,
  position = {0,0.1,0},
  height = 1500,
  width = 1500,
  color = {0,0,0,0}
  })

function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
  mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
  new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
  if val ~= new_val then
    val = new_val
  end
  self.editInput({index = 0, value = val})
  name_update()
end

self.createInput({
  value = tostring(val),
  validation = 2,
  input_function = "change_val",
  function_owner = self,
  position = {-0.5,0.1,-0.45},
  alignment = 3,
  height = 800,
  width = 900,
  font_size = 750,
  font_color = text_color,
  color = {0,0,0,0}
  })

function change_val(obj, player_clicker_color, input_value, selected)
  val = input_value
  name_update()
end

self.createButton({
  label = "/",
  click_function = "null",
  function_owner = self,
  position = {0.45,0.1,-0.2},
  height = 0,
  width = 0,
  font_size = 250,
  font_color = text_color,
  color = {0,0,0,0}
  })

self.createInput({
  value = tostring(max_val),
  validation = 2,
  input_function = "change_max_val",
  function_owner = self,
  position = {1,0.1,-0.18},
  alignment = 3,
  height = 300,
  width = 500,
  font_size = 250,
  font_color = text_color,
  color = {0,0,0,0}
  })

function change_max_val(obj, player_clicker_color, input_value, selected)
  max_val = input_value
  name_update()
end

self.createButton({
  label = "- " .. label .. " +",
  click_function = "null",
  function_owner = self,
  position = {0,0.1,1},
  height = 0,
  width = 0,
  font_size = 250,
  font_color = text_color,
  color = {0,0,0,0}
  })

label = "HQ Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,100}

min_val = 0
val = self.getName()
max_val = self.getDescription()

if not val then
  val = 10
end
if not max_val then
  max_val = 20
end

function name_update()
  self.setName(val)
  self.setDescription(max_val)
  self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
end

self.createButton({
  tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
  click_function = "increment_val",
  function_owner = self,
  position = {0,0.1,0},
  height = 1500,
  width = 1500,
  color = {0,0,0,0}
  })

function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
  mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
  new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
  if val ~= new_val then
    val = new_val
  end
  self.editInput({index = 0, value = val})
  name_update()
end

self.createInput({
  value = tostring(val),
  validation = 2,
  input_function = "change_val",
  function_owner = self,
  position = {-0.5,0.1,-0.45},

  height = 800,

  font_size = 750,
  font_color = text_color,
  color = {0,0,0,0}
  })

function change_val(obj, player_clicker_color, input_value, selected)
  val = input_value
  name_update()
end

self.createButton({
  label = "/",
  click_function = "null",
  function_owner = self,
  position = {0.45,0.1,-0.2},
  height = 0,
  width = 0,
  font_size = 250,

  function_owner = self,
  position = {1,0.1,-0.18},
  alignment = 3,
  height = 300,
  width = 500,
  font_size = 250,
  font_color = text_color,
  color = {0,0,0,0}
  })

function change_max_val(obj, player_clicker_color, input_value, selected)
  max_val = input_value
  name_update()
end

  height = 0,
  width = 0,

  })

MSL_4_IMG = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/13975766137257302393/91C63BB27A88589C427CF7327ED998BD7496D1CE/"

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHitWithFlip)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit w/o flip", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
	    if isFlipped() then
	       hit_flipped = true
            end
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHitWithFlip()
    if not hit_count or not hit_flipped then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
	    hit_flipped = true
        end
	
	if not hit_count then
            hit_count = 1
	end
    else
	incrementHit()
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
	hit_count = 1
    end

    if hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token or hit_count then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
	hit_flipped = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 3
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_3"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
